title: Agent scenario (scenarios/*.json)
description: One agent scenario: id, turns, expected_tools, must_include, expected_outcome, and an optional success_criteria. A $defs entry with a description is a message rule. Fix: write each scenario as a JSON object with id (string), turns ([{"user": ...}]), expected_tools and must_include (lists of strings), and expected_outcome.
$comment: source: house (eva.py scenario_errors, scenario v1); severity: fail (the scenarios-valid row of check_agent, must; no bundle rule, brief D2); protects: claude, codex, opencode, hermes.

scenario-object.description: scenario must be a JSON object, got %(type)s

expected-tools.description: expected_tools: non-empty list of strings required

must-include.description: must_include: non-empty list of strings required

expected-outcome.description: expected_outcome: non-empty string or list of strings required

success-criteria.description: success_criteria: non-empty string or list of strings required
